426:t_011:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「The fourth $$サイデリアル$$ Reactor...!」

426:t_011:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「The zodiac constellations that haven't shown up yet are Sagittarius and Pisces...!」

426:t_011:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Assuming $$アサキム$$ holds one of them, is the last one still with $$サイデリアル$$...!」

426:t_013:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「As promised, I've brought Miss $$スズネ$$, whom you all love so much.」

426:t_013:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$バルビエル$$! You bastard, what did you do to Miss $$スズネ$$!?」

426:t_013:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I did nothing. That is her true form, after all.」

426:t_013:4.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$! Why are you riding $$ジェミニア#robot$$!?」

426:t_013:5.en:
???
「This...? I repaired the one that good-for-nothing used to ride. It's not a bad ride.」

426:t_013:6.en:
???
「But there's one crucial thing this machine lacks.」

426:t_013:8.en:
???
「That's right, $n. I'm taking back the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

426:t_013:10.en:
???
「Or will you get out of $$ジェニオン$$? That would suit me better, too.」

426:t_013:12.en:
???
「You don't have to say it. I know your answer is NO. We go back a long way.」

426:t_013:13.en:
???
「But you see, $$ジェニオン$$ was originally the machine I was supposed to ride.」

426:t_013:15.en:
$$宗介$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is $$ジェニオン$$'s real pilot...!?」

426:t_013:18.en:
???
「It's pointless to ask that dolt, so I'll tell you myself. Like a teacher should.」

426:t_013:19.en:
???
「$$ジェニオン$$ was built to resemble $$ジェミニア#robot$$ so that it could steal its $$スフィア$$... a crude imitation, as $$ガドライト#pilot$$ put it.」

426:t_013:20.en:
???
「But with me as its pilot, $$ジェニオン$$ was supposed to take the $$スフィア$$ from $$ジェミニア#robot$$ and become a perfect $$ＤＥＭ$$.」

426:t_013:22.en:
???
「Admit it, $n. That is the truth about $$ジェニオン$$.」

426:t_013:23.en:
$n
「Stop it, Miss $$スズネ$$! What are you saying!」

426:t_013:24.en:
???
「I am $$西条涼音$$, and yet I am not $$西条涼音$$.」

426:t_013:25.en:
???
「Needless to say, I'm not under any mind control. That must be a disappointment for you.」

426:t_013:27.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I find it unpleasant to keep being called by that name. My name is... yes, $$アムブリエル$$.」

426:t_013:28.en:
$$万丈$$
「The name of the angel of Gemini, the twin sign of the zodiac?」

426:t_014:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「What a foolish boy.」

426:t_015:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Calling out is useless. Soon he will feel neither pain nor sorrow.」

426:t_015:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「It's the $$スフィアの反作用$$!」

426:t_015:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The hope of facing the woman he loves, and the despair of having his life taken by that same woman... That is what will break $n's mind.」

426:t_015:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「He truly seems to have been born under a star of being betrayed by those he loves.」

426:t_016:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now, $$アムブリエル$$. As the rightful owner of the $$いがみ合う双子$$, drag him out of the cockpit.」

426:t_016:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Don't give me orders, $$バルビエル$$.」

426:t_018:1.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「A good opportunity. $$揺れる天秤$$, $$クロウ・ブルースト$$... I will erase you.」

426:t_018:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Am I in your way, like $$セツコ$$ is to $$バルビエル$$?」

426:t_018:3.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「The Spheres have nothing to do with it.」

426:t_018:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's the first time you've shown emotion, $$尸空#pilot$$!」

426:t_018:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Hurry up, $$尸空#pilot$$! He's coming!」

426:t_019:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「That machine... Is it $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

426:t_019:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「He seems to have come to save $n from danger.」

426:t_019:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Exactly. Leave him to me.」

426:t_019:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This much is no crisis at all! Not for $n, and not for me either!」

426:t_020:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$... I still just don't like being looked after by anyone.」

426:t_020:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'll show you I can move forward on my own strength!」

426:t_020:3.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「$$クロウ・ブルースト$$...! That strong will of yours disturbs my existence...!」

426:t_021:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Looks like you got over the wall too.」

426:t_021:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's right, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. It's the same for $n.」
